fix: En Montage, cuando la ruta no esté construida (isBuilt de src/lib/site), pintar la fila como <div class="mt__link"> sin 'Ver caso'. Así ya se hace con las filas planeadas de ScriptList. Al construir los casos vuelven solas.

section: Encabezado, mega menú, menú móvil, footer
problem: Desde el inicio salen 42 rutas internas distintas que hoy dan 404: servicios, industrias, casos, /kain/, /metodologia/, /nosotros/, el blog, /aviso-privacidad/, etc. El sitio 'muy completo y multipágina' que pidió el cliente en la práctica son 4 páginas. Cualquier clic en el menú lleva a un 404.
evidence: El script de enlaces sobre el HTML de / encontró 47 rutas internas, de las que 42 dan 404. check-seo: '35 de 39 páginas indexables siguen sin construir'. vercel.json redirige a 10 destinos sin construir. El mega menú de Servicios (cd/mm-after.png) enlaza 11 servicios y 'Conoce el protocolo completo' a rutas 404.
fix: Construir las 35 páginas pendientes con sus plantillas antes de lanzar. Si se lanza por fases, el nav, el mega menú, el footer y vercel.json deben filtrar con isBuilt() y pintar lo planeado como texto, nunca un <a> a un 404.

problem: Las costuras entre secciones se leen como bandas y cortes rectos, justo el 'dos secciones separadas' que el cliente rechaza. 02 pinta una franja navy de lado a lado con el borde inferior casi duro. Al terminar la escena gemela 03, la 04 arranca con una línea horizontal recta y más clara. Además, la escena fijada mide 842 px en una ventana de 900.
evidence: cd/p-00-900.png (franja clara bajo los logos y barra oscura antes del hombre), homeqa-x7/seam-s.png (línea recta a y≈842 al pie de la escena gemela, donde empieza la luz de #que-es). Medido: #problema bottom 842 = #que-es top 842. .tpl-glow::before usa una máscara de 5 %/95 %: en una sección de 289 px el fundido dura 14 px.
fix: Fundir la luz base con un tramo fijo en px, no en %: mask linear-gradient(transparent 0, #000 160px, #000 calc(100% - 160px), transparent). En secciones cortas como #stack, bajar las elipses o quitarlas. La escena gemela debe medir 100svh y terminar en --ink con una disolución de al menos 25 % (§3.11-6), y la siguiente sección debe empezar dentro de esa disolución.

problem: El HUD vertical de la derecha ('23:48' o 'RESPONDIDO' y '02:14 · KAIN ATIENDE') choca con el H2 y el lede: la columna de texto llega a la misma x que el HUD. Pasa en el tamaño de escritorio más común.
evidence: Medido a 1440x900: el H2 de #problema llega a x=1350 y el HUD .hud--tr ocupa x 1336–1350. En #kain el H2 va de 748 a 1350 y el lede de 748 a 1346, y el HUD va de 1336 a 1350 (y 104–271). files: src/styles/cine.css:102,107 (.hud--tr) y la columna .is__copy de ImageSection/TwinScene

problem: La tarjeta 'SIMULACIÓN' del chat del sector tapa los nombres de la lista de industrias ('Industrial y logística', 'Inmobiliario', 'Retail y e-commerce'). En escritorio hay texto encimado por una tarjeta.

problem: El fotograma 21:9 del riel de servicios se ve como una imagen en caja: un rectángulo oscuro con aristas rectas arriba y a los lados. Va contra R7 y §3.11-3, la regla del cliente de 'nunca dos cajas'.

problem: El equipo aparece como 6 fotos rectangulares en fila (en móvil, en una retícula de 3×2) bajo un bloque de texto, con un filo superior recto. Es justo la 'foto rectangular de una persona' y el 'texto arriba, imágenes abajo' que prohíbe §3.11-12, y es la única sección de personas del inicio.
evidence: cd/s-e-07-14132.png y homeqa-x7/team.png: borde superior recto de los retratos a lo ancho y cada retrato con caja oscura. qa-home/tramos/celular-11/12: retícula de retratos en caja.

Si no, reducir la sección a TeamCredits solo con texto y llevar el rostro del equipo a /nosotros/. Con la sesión hecha, usar la placa equipo-real a sangre.

problem: En móvil, la escena de Kain muestra un teléfono de cristal vacío en la placa. Después pone el chat como una tarjeta de 802 px de alto (casi una pantalla) con 2–3 burbujas y más de 400 px vacíos. Se lee como dos bloques: imagen arriba y caja de chat abajo.

problem: El copy del inicio sigue en estado 'borrador' sin aprobadoPor. Según R1, solo 'aprobado' se publica, así que la página no pasa la puerta de lanzamiento.
evidence: src/content/paginas/home.json:4 "estado": "borrador". check-pendientes: '/ · copy en estado "borrador" (aprobadoPor: —)'.

problem: La tarjeta viajera 'LEAD NUEVO' tapa el encabezado 'EMBUDO DE VENTAS' y el chip SIMULACIÓN del kanban (estación 3) y el chip SIMULACIÓN del tablero (estación 5). En la estación 3, alinear las columnas HTML a los carriles de la placa o dejar solo la tarjeta en un carril.

problem: La línea de confianza toca el borde del pie de foto Fig. 01: el último '·' termina en x=615 y la caja del pie empieza en x=612.

problem: A 2560 px, la placa de Kain deja a la izquierda un rectángulo casi negro con esquina visible (filo vertical y horizontal suave). Por debajo asoma la luz de la sección de servicios: se lee como una caja.

problem: Una respuesta promete 'resultados medibles en 60 a 90 días' como plazo general. Esa cifra no está en metrics.ts y la guarda de cifras no la detecta.
evidence: src/data/faq.json:140-141 (G07) y :520. Visible en el acordeón del inicio y en el JSON-LD FAQPage.
fix: Pedir al cliente la confirmación por escrito. Si no la da, reescribir sin plazo general (citar solo los plazos de los casos, que ya traen sus cifras) o marcarlo como un compromiso de alcance que se define en la Discovery Session.

problem: Los contadores del mapa del sitio ('12', '09'…) tienen un contraste de 2.94:1 a 11 px, debajo de AA.
evidence: Sonda de contraste: .ftr__n color rgba(158,176,199,.5) sobre #03040B = 2.94:1, fs 11px.

problem: Siguen abiertos fallos y huecos de guardas. public/fx/noise.webp pesa 7 KB contra 6 KB. Las páginas /dev/* y /dev-movil.html se publican en dist; robots.txt solo aplica 'Disallow: /dev/' a '*', y los grupos de GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot y demás tienen 'Allow: /'. No existen check-escenas.mjs ni check-contraste.mjs, así que R3/R4 y el contraste AA de §3.10 siguen sin medirse.
evidence: node scripts/check.mjs --only /: 'pesos ✗ public/fx/noise.webp: 7 KB > 6 KB'. dist/ contiene dev/ y dev-movil.html. curl /robots.txt. scripts/ sin check-escenas ni check-contraste.
files: public/fx/noise.webp, public/robots.txt, src/pages/dev/*, public/dev-movil.html, astro.config.mjs, scripts/
fix: Recomprimir el grano a ≤ 6 KB. Excluir /dev/ y dev-movil.html del build de producción (o moverlos a un modo dev) y repetir 'Disallow: /dev/' en cada grupo de bot. Escribir check-escenas.mjs (safe/subject, R3/R4) y check-contraste.mjs antes de lanzar.

problem: The registered lead panel (.svc-lead, anchors layer z-index 2, opaque gradient rgb(6 10 24/.86) with cyan inset border) paints over the copy. At 1024x768 it covers the right part of the H2 ('IA,') and the lede ('con IA', 'menú'). At 1280–2560 it reaches below the plate floor and hides the cyan table header 'AGENTE DE IA' and dims row 1 ('opciones fijas.', 'Entiende lo que'). The image reads as a box sitting on top of the text.
evidence: Overlap measured in the DOM. At 1024: .svc-lead {l395 r692 t4887 b5536} intersects H2 {l64 r427 t4934 b5093} and lede {t5141 b5261}. At 1440: panel bottom is 5519–5542 and the thead starts at 5454/5517 (it grows with the cam 1.35→1.6 scrub). Screenshots: scratchpad/svcrev/d1024/_vs-chatbot.png, d1440/_vs-chatbot.png, d1440b/_vs-chatbot@500.png, d1280/_vs-chatbot.png, d1920/_vs-chatbot.png.
fix: Clip the anchors layer to the stagebox: .svc-back > .is__stagebox{overflow:hidden} with the media/anchors layers inside it. Cap the panel so --ay+--ah×cam ends at the plate floor (≈0.84), and drop the opaque fill so the plate's own phone glass shows and only the UI cards are painted. Put .svc-back > .is__more{position:relative;z-index:3}. Below 1200px, keep the text in cols 1–4 or move the panel's x to ≥0.45. Re-check at 1024x768, 1280x720, 1440x900 and 2560x1080.

problem: On ultrawide the pushed plate ends in a near-vertical edge with only ~80 px of fade that slices through Kain's right shoulder and arm. A straight image edge is visible and Kain is cut in half. This breaks the client must-have (no visible image edge; Kain never cut at 2560x1080).
evidence: Brightness along y=540 of d2560/_vs-chatbot.png falls from 111 at x=2120 to 6 at x=2200 across Kain's body. Crop: scratchpad/svcrev/vs2560-r.png. At 1920 the right arm is cut by the side fade (d1920/_vs-chatbot.png).
files: src/styles/cine.css (is__layer--media side mask / ultrawide cap with push), src/styles/pages.css .svc-back
fix: When push > 1, compute the side mask relative to the viewport rather than the capped stage, or let the stage stay full-bleed. Use a side fade of at least 15–18 % that never falls on the subject box. Alternatively, choose the push anchor or plate so Kain stays fully inside the safe area at 1920 and 2560.

problem: The 'regreso al set' push (cam 1.35→1.6) crops Kain at every desktop size. The antennas are cut off at the section top, the legs dissolve at knee height into the table, and the right arm leaves the frame. Brand rule §0.1.5 says Kain is always shown full body; here he reads as an accidental crop, not a deliberate close-up.
evidence: d1440/_vs-chatbot.png: head touches y=0 with no antennas. d1440/_vs-chatbot@700.png: legs end at the table. d1920/_vs-chatbot.png: arm cut at the right edge.
fix: Option 1: push hard enough into the phone that Kain leaves the frame entirely, showing only glass plus UI (a true insert shot). Option 2: give this section its own plate with a different full-body pose (R13), with the lead card registered on a lit panel. Do not leave a half-cropped Kain.

problem: On the vertical plate the 'regreso al set' scene repeats the hero's exact framing and UI: the same Kain pose, the same phone and the same 'kain.' mini screen with bars. The push is not applied and the lead card is display:none. R5 says the same framing is never shown twice on one page, and to the user it looks like the hero image pasted again.
evidence: m390/0.png vs m390/_vs-chatbot.png; t768/0.png vs t768/_vs-chatbot.png. Same composition and the same .svc-lead__mini UI (pages.css:1171-1176 hides .svc-lead__card on mobile).
fix: Apply the push on the vertical plate too (crop to the phone and show the lead-stage card, or the inline version in the 'more' slot). Otherwise use a different plate or pose for this section on mobile, or omit the plate there and keep the table in the dissolve of the previous scene.

problem: A sticky isotipo aura (o=0.9, only='m') moves behind the text column and turns into a bright cyan blob directly under body copy. Muted lines like 'Entiende lo que escribe el cliente…' and 'Tu CRM, tu calendario y los sistemas…' become nearly unreadable (WCAG 1.4.3 fail).
evidence: Background luminance between the text lines is 0.37–0.45 (rgb 41,184,213). Muted text is rgb(164,181,202), L≈0.45, which gives about 1.1:1; white text gives about 2.4:1. Screenshots: m390/_capacidades.png y 470–520, m390/_capacidades@800.png y 440–500, m390/_inversion.png y 455–500.
files: src/components/templates/ServiceTemplate.astro:399 and :702 (<Aura kind="isotipo" … o={0.9} only="m" sticky>), src/components/templates/Aura.astro
fix: On mobile, lower the isotipo aura to o≤0.3, or move its centre outside the text column (x≥95 %) and below the lines. Add a text-side veil, or use the darker 'ondas' aura. Verify ≥4.5:1 under every line at 360 and 390.

problem: The signals list keeps its 2-column grid inside a ~280 px text column, so lines wrap after 1–2 words ('Kain / responde en / segundos, / con la / información / de tu / negocio.'). It is hard to read, and the section grows far past the plate.
evidence: d1024/_senales.png: each column is about 120 px wide.
files: src/styles/pages.css (.svc-signals / .pain__list grid in the senales block)

problem: 'Ver caso →' on the +340 % retail row links to /casos/retail-multimarca-kommo/, which is not built and returns 404. The template filters unbuilt targets everywhere else (R12, no dead body links), but Montage links METRICS.href unconditionally.

problem: From #casos (y≈6724) to #cta-final (y≈12320), about 6.2 screens, there are 8 consecutive sections of text on the same blurred navy aura with no generated scene: integraciones, industrias, vktor, inversión, faq, relacionados, with only dim montage stills and three small still cards. Every section repeats the same eyebrow, two-voice H2 and hairline-list formula. It reads as a template rather than the Awwwards-level, image-led site the client asked for. The integrated image sections stop after #vs-chatbot until the closing Dawn.
evidence: Section offsets from the DOM, plus d1440/_integraciones.png, _industrias.png, _vktor.png, _inversion.png, _faq.png and qa-svc/escritorio-completa.png.
fix: Add at least one full-bleed ImageSection in that stretch, for example integraciones or inversión over a plate with Kain in a new pose (R13: sitting, or arms crossed at a lit panel showing the 5 tool logos registered), or industrias as a LocationSwitcher on sector plates. Vary the layout rhythm: one mega-type intertitle and one asymmetric full-bleed figure.

problem: The page copy is still unapproved. R1 says only 'aprobado' copy is published, so the page cannot launch as is.
evidence: src/content/paginas/agentes-whatsapp.json: estado='borrador', autor='Equipo de Ingeniak (redactado con IA)', aprobadoPor=null.

problem: The stills are rendered as dark rectangular cards: a hard top hairline, hard bottom and side edges, and a fill darker than the surrounding aura. They stack as 255 px boxes on mobile. Montage rows show a lighter image band with hard edges at the row hairlines, and the 'más citas en 90 días' meta sits over the ghosted dentist's torso. This contradicts R7/§3.11 #3 (no image box, mask to --ink). The Discovery still also repeats its label as the title ('DISCOVERY SESSION' / 'Discovery Session').
evidence: Screenshots: d1440/_relacionados.png, rel-crop.png, m390/_relacionados.png, casos-crop.png.
fix: Mask still edges to transparent (bottom and sides to --ink), remove the card fill and top hairline, and keep the text inside the penumbra. Feather the montage band top and bottom (mask-image linear 0→12 %) and keep the meta outside the subject box. When the label equals the title, use 'Agenda' or 'Conversión' as the label.

problem: The 5th VktorRail step (R · Rise) never gets is-lit at any scroll position, so the 'results' phase stays permanently greyed, as if disabled.
evidence: vrail__step classes sampled at offsets -600…+900 px from the section top: steps 1–4 are 'is-lit' and step 5 never is. Screenshot: d1440h/_vktor@300.png.

problem: At the most common desktop widths the hero has nothing tying subject and copy together. svg.branch is display:none because the ghost CTA blocks every route, and there is no Fig. caption. The branch does draw at 1024 and 1280, so the composition is inconsistent (§3.11 #7).
evidence: svg.branch computed display:none at 1440 (branch.js probe). The line is visible in d1024/0.png and d1280/0.png.

problem: The Fig. 02 caption is an oversized glass box holding only a mono label that breaks badly ('LO QUE PASA A LAS / 11:48 P. M.'), with about 45 % empty width. It also hangs below the section and shows at the top of #capacidades.
evidence: Screenshots: d1440/_senales.png and d1440/_capacidades.png (top edge), d2560/_senales.png.

problem: In the mobile and tablet hero the secondary CTA is an icon-only WhatsApp circle beside the microcopy. The visible label 'Escríbele a Kain' required by the brand rule is hidden, while the same page's closing section shows it.
evidence: m390/0.png, m360/0.png, t768/0.png compared with m390/_cta-final.png.

fix: Show the label: either a full-width ghost button under the microcopy, or an icon plus the 'Escríbele a Kain' text link.

evidence: Screenshot: d1024/0.png, y 120–190.

problem: The JS and image budgets still fail on this page. The BaseLayout bundle is 62.8 KB gzip against a 60 KB limit (gsap and ScrollTrigger are imported statically in cine.ts), and two SharedTake rack have no width/height.
evidence: gzip of dist/_astro/BaseLayout.astro_astro_type_script_index_0_lang.CpRH3bTU.js is 62,790 bytes. DOM audit: home-sistema-2-atender-rack-320.webp ×2 with no width/height.

problem: On mobile the VSL poster plate renders at about 45% of its brightness. The desktop bottom-up veil (.94→.72→.2) stays on because a CSS specificity bug beats the mobile override. The chair, the scene's subject, sits in the lower half of the 4:5 plate and comes out muddy, so the scene reads as text plus play button on flat ink with a dim image strip after it. This breaks the 'image as full background' must-have, and the same bug hits every subject-center ImageSection on mobile across the site.
evidence: Computed .is__fx on #video at 390x844: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(3,4,11,.94) 0%, rgba(3,4,11,.72) 22%, … ). The mobile rule `.is__fx{background:linear-gradient(180deg,…/.55) 0,transparent 12%)}` (cine.css:130, specificity 0,1,0) loses to `.is[data-layout="subject-center"] .is__fx` (cine.css:60, 0,3,0). Brightest panel pixel: source plate discovery-vsl-poster-m (199,242,255), rendered (88,114,125). Captures: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/m390/video.png and t768/video.png
fix: Inside the mobile media query (max-width:767px),(max-aspect-ratio:5/6), add an override with equal or higher specificity: `.is[data-layout] .is__fx, .is[data-layout="subject-center"] .is__fx{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(3 4 11/.55) 0,transparent 12%)}`. The mobile scrim then comes from the top, where the text is. Re-capture at 390 and 768 and check that the play button and text sit over the plate's dark upper zone.

problem: The next section (#despues Intertitle) paints its aura over the last items of the 'Es para ti si… / No es para ti si…' lists. The overlap seam pulls #despues up, and its z-index:1 stacking context paints above #para-quien, so the blurred isotipo aura darkens parts of the list text. Words like 'invertir en implementación' and 'seria antes' render grey even though their computed colour is #fff.
evidence: #despues: z-index 1, isolation isolate, margin-top -108px. Its .it__aura--isotipo (990x990, top=537 at scroll 4209) covers li[3] of the left list and items 3–4 of the right list. Hiding the aura turns the text white again. Compare /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/d1440b/zoom-li.png with zoom-li-noaura.png. The same dimming shows in qa-disc/tramos/escritorio-03.png and celular-04.png.
fix: Never let a following Intertitle stack above the previous ImageSection's copy. Either give `.is + .it` z-index:auto with its aura at z-index:-1 inside main, or lift `.is__more`/`.is__copy` to z-index ≥2. Or start the Intertitle's aura below its own top seam (clip the aura with `overflow:clip` on the top --seam).

problem: On desktop the fit lists in the `more` slot span the full width under the plate and start about 70 px above the plate's end. The 'Es para ti si…' heading and first items sit over the subject's lower body, chair and desk legs. That breaks §3.10.1 (no text inside the subject box) and R3 ('En escritorio more sigue en la misma columna de texto'), and it reads as text pasted on a photo instead of one composed scene.
evidence: plates.json discovery-para-quien subject.d=[0.05,0.11,0.44,0.98]. pages.css:567-572: --fit-h:max(88svh,600px), lists 'nacen bajo los pies del sujeto… alto del plano − 70 px', `.is.cv-fit[data-layout] > .is__more .is__text{grid-column:1 / -1}`. Captures: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/d1440/paraquien.png (heading at y≈786 over the chair legs), d1024/pq.png, d2560/zoom-pq-left.png
fix: Keep `more` in the text column on desktop (grid-column 8 / span 5, the same as .is__text) so the lists sit under the lede on the right. Or start the lists at least 24 px below the subject's bottom: --fit-h ≥ subject bottom, with a lower fadeFrom (≈.80) so the chair legs dissolve to ink before the first list row.

problem: The step descriptions (.steps__line, --muted #9EB0C7, 16 px) sit on bright cyan aura blobs and fail WCAG AA contrast. §3.10.3 allows --muted only where the composite background luminance is ≤ 0.054.
evidence: 390x844: 'Siete preguntas sobre tu negocio…' over aura pixel (22,161,201), luminance ≈ 0.30, ≈ 1.4:1. 1440x900: step 03 'Al confirmar tu horario…' over (21,89,127) and (29,93,116), luminance 0.09, ≈ 3.3–3.4:1. Captures: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/m390/zoom-step1.png and advdisc/out-d/pasos.png

For example, park them at x ≥ 85% or behind the empty area, at ≤ .35 opacity under copy. Where an aura must stay, switch .steps__line to --text-2. No boxes behind the text.

problem: The secondary CTA reads 'Escríbenos por WhatsApp' instead of the brand rule's 'Escríbele a Kain'. On mobile and tablet portrait the hero secondary collapses to an unlabeled WhatsApp icon circle, so the brand's second action has no visible text in the first screen.
evidence: src/content/paginas/discovery.json hero.ctaSecondary.label and faq.ctaSecondary.label = 'Escríbenos por WhatsApp'. Rendered at 1440: 'Escríbenos por WhatsApp' (escritorio-primera-pantalla.png). At 390, an icon-only .cv-wa circle next to the micro line (m390/hero.png).

problem: The offer messaging contradicts itself. The first screen says 'No entregamos nada: diagnosticamos.' directly under 'sales con sugerencias concretas'. Later the page promises 'preparamos una propuesta de implementación: qué se hace, en qué orden, en cuánto tiempo y cuánto cuesta' (also in FAQ D04). 'No es consultoría: es descubrimiento' clashes with the footer entity 'Ingeniak · consultoría de IA' and the 'Consultoría en IA' service. A negative 'you get nothing' line in the conversion hero hurts sign-ups and reads as inconsistent.
evidence: discovery.json hero.remate, que-es.right.items[0] and [3], despues.body[0], FAQ D04 in JSON-LD. Desktop hero capture shows the lede and remate in one viewport.
fix: Rewrite the remate, for example: 'No es una venta: es un diagnóstico. Sales con sugerencias concretas y, si tiene sentido, una propuesta con alcance y costo.' Reword 'No es consultoría' to 'No es el proyecto de consultoría: es el descubrimiento previo.' Get client approval (R1).

problem: SplitText line masks stay on the page after the reveal (overflow:clip, line-height .95, no bottom padding), so descenders get clipped. The 'g' in 'de agendar.' is visibly cut flat at desktop and mobile, a clear amateur tell for an Awwwards-level brief. All 7 H2s on the page keep their masks, so any line with g/j/p/q/y is at risk.
evidence: DOM after reveal: video-t masks=2, pasos-t 1, que-es-t 2, para-quien-t 2, despues-t 3, faq-t 2, cta-final-t 4. All have .split-mask-line-mask overflow:clip and padding-bottom 0. Captures: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/d1440/zoom-agendar.png and advdisc/zoom-m-agendar.png
fix: Call split.revert() in the reveal's onComplete, or create the mask with breathing room: `.split-mask-line-mask{padding-bottom:.2em;margin-bottom:-.2em}` (and the same padding-top/margin-top for accents). Also do not keep scroll-parallax transforms on masked lines.

problem: The VSL plays with sound, has 0 text tracks and no .vtt file exists, which fails WCAG 1.2.2 (Level A) and R11/R14. The file is also over its R14 budget. The dialog itself works: focus goes to Close, Tab stays inside, Esc closes and returns focus.
evidence: CDP after clicking play: dialog open=true, textTracks=0, paused=false, muted=false. `ls public/video/*.vtt` returns no matches. public/video/discovery-vsl-720.mp4 = 12,828,095 B (12.83 MB > 12 MB, also flagged by check-pesos). ConversionTemplate sets vsl.captions to undefined.
fix: Transcribe the 3:00 VSL into public/video/discovery-vsl.es.vtt and pass `vsl={{src, captions:'/video/discovery-vsl.es.vtt'}}`; the track renders with default. Re-encode to ≤ 12 MB: 720p H.264 two-pass at about 480–500 kbps video and 96 kbps AAC, with +faststart.

problem: The page ships 65 KB of gzip JS against the 60 KB budget for internal pages (§7.8). gsap and ScrollTrigger are imported statically in cine.ts, and main.ts imports cine statically, so the dynamic imports cannot split them out.
evidence: dist/discovery/index.html loads /_astro/BaseLayout…CpRH3bTU.js = 62,790 B gzip + page.js 1,028 B. check.mjs: '✗ /discovery/ · JS gzip 65 KB > 60 KB'. dist (05:34) is newer than the sources (cine.ts 04:20, ConversionTemplate 05:24). src/scripts/cine.ts:15-16 imports gsap and ScrollTrigger statically.
fix: Load gsap and ScrollTrigger with `await import()` inside initCine only when the page has [data-shot]/[data-split] (all heavy shots already lazy). Keep Lenis lazy and drop it on reduced motion. Re-measure with check-pesos.

problem: The conversion page measures nothing. agenda_click, video_play/50/complete and faq_open are dispatched as `ingeniak:track` events, but no code listens for them, and Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights (required 'desde el día 1' by R10) are not installed. Agenda clicks, the page's key conversion, are invisible to the team.
evidence: grep finds no addEventListener('ingeniak:track') in src. package.json, astro.config.mjs and BaseLayout have no analytics or insights. The page HTML has no consent, analytics or insights markup.
fix: Add @vercel/analytics and @vercel/speed-insights (cookieless) in BaseLayout, plus a small listener in main.ts that maps `ingeniak:track` detail to va.track(name, {page, section}). Keep pixels behind the R10 consent banner.

section: FAQ D05, footer, JSON-LD, every wa.me link
problem: The WhatsApp/phone number is still an open client question, yet it is published everywhere on the conversion page. If the other number is the right one, every 'Escríbele a Kain' click goes to the wrong line. §12.3 requires written confirmation or omission.
evidence: discovery.json pendientes: 'PREGUNTA AL CLIENTE · teléfono único de la respuesta D05 (33 2101 7799 frente a 33 2101 2962 del Sales Brief, D §15)'. Published in the FAQ D05 answer, the footer WhatsApp row, the JSON-LD contactPoint.telephone '+523321017799', and wa.me/523321017799 in the hero, FAQ and footer.

problem: The copy is still 'borrador' with no approver, the FAQ answers differ from D in all six items, and 'Nadie te va a perseguir…' is an unconfirmed commercial promise. The page is still served index,follow and listed in the sitemap, against R1 ('solo aprobado se publica').

fix: Get the client to sign off (aprobadoPor) on the page copy and on the six FAQ deltas. Until then, make check-contenido fail the deploy (or emit noindex) for non-approved pages.

problem: On mobile the 4:5 plates put a very small subject in the right third and leave about 55% empty dark wall. Each scene reads as a small photo below the text block, not a full-bleed background with the person on one side, which fails the client's must-have on the device most visitors use. Kain, the brand hero of the closing scene, is about 130 CSS px tall.
evidence: plates.json discovery-hero subject.m=[0.57,0.49,0.85,0.93]: the man is about 210 CSS px tall on a 390x844 screen. Captures: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/m390/hero.png, m390/dawn.png, m390/pq.png, t768/hero.png. Source plate: advdisc/hero-m.png.
fix: Regenerate the mobile 4:5 plates (or re-crop from the 2752 masters) with the subject at ≥ 55–60% of plate height, centred or slightly right, and the dark negative space only in the top 40% under the intro. Kain must stay full body but closer to camera. Update subject.m, subjTop and anchors in the plate cards and re-run plates.mjs.

problem: The scroll-linked text parallax fades H2s while they are still in the prime reading zone. The bottom-anchored VSL headline drops to .69 opacity with its top at y=249 px, so the scene's headline looks washed out next to its lede.
evidence: CDP: #video-t effective opacity 0.91 at top=515 and 0.69 at top=249; #para-quien-t 0.66. Capture: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/d1440/video2.png
fix: Start the fade only once the heading's top passes about 15% of the viewport (trigger 'top 15%' → 'bottom top'), or skip the opacity fade on align=end scenes and keep only the −60 px translate.

problem: The micro line '30 min · 1:1 · Google Meet · sin costo' wraps onto two lines with a dangling '·' because the WhatsApp icon sits beside it. On tablet portrait the primary CTA stretches to about 655 px, a phone layout blown up.
evidence: m390/hero.png ('30 min · 1:1 ·' / 'Google Meet · sin costo'), t768/hero.png (full-width pill with the node at the far right).
fix: Put the micro line alone under the primary on one line and the WhatsApp ghost button on its own row with a label. Cap .ctas .btn at about 420 px from 600 px up.

problem: The horizon arc's cyan edge cuts across the chair's star base directly under Kain's feet, so the closing art looks like a line drawn over the subject rather than a floor.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/d1440/dawn2.png (arc at y≈550 crossing the chair base at x 870–1230)
fix: Drop the arc below the plate's floor line for this plate (per-plate --horizon-y), or start the bottom dissolve above the arc so the chair base fades before the line crosses it.

problem: No scene on the page has a FigCaption or LightBranch to stitch subject and copy (§3.11.7), although plates.json defines `fig` anchors for discovery-hero and discovery-para-quien. The scenes rely only on the veil.
evidence: Hero, video, para-quien and cta-final sections in the HTML contain no figcap, branch, anchor or leader elements. plates.json discovery-hero anchors.fig.d=[0.72,0.85], discovery-para-quien anchors.fig.d=[0.47,0.88].
fix: Add a FigCaption (desktop only, data-m="none") at the existing fig anchors, e.g. 'Tu silla, vacía 30 minutos' on the hero, or a LightBranch from the woman's laptop to the H2 in #para-quien.

problem: The middle of the page is one long stretch of lists over blurred auras with no subject: about 2,000 px on desktop and about 3,000 px on mobile (#que-es alone is 2,007 px at 390, with 13 list rows). It is the weakest part of the 'premium/disruptive' brief, and the mobile page runs 14 screens for a conversion page.
evidence: Section heights: desktop pasos 755 + que-es 1,326; mobile pasos 1,000 + que-es 2,007; full mobile page 11,381 px (revisar-sitio resultado.json).
fix: Turn #que-es into an ImageSection with a plate (e.g. Kain with a clipboard, a different pose from the Dawn per R13), or move 'En la llamada revisamos' into a compact numbered row or accordion to cut about 600 px on mobile.

problem: Repetition and style slips. 'letra chica' appears three times ('Tres pasos, cero letra chica', 'Sin presión y sin letra chica', FAQ eyebrow 'Sin letra chica'). The desktop first screen states 1:1 and free three times (chip, lede, micro). The page uses two different micro texts. 'PyMES' appears in the meta description and JSON-LD where the correct form is 'pymes'.
evidence: discovery.json (pasos.eyebrow, despues.body[0], faq.eyebrow, cta-final.micro). Meta description: 'para dueños de PyMES'.
fix: Vary the eyebrows (e.g. FAQ 'Antes de agendar'), drop '1:1 y gratuita' from the desktop lede, use the single §2.9 micro everywhere, and write 'pymes'.

problem: Without JS the play button does nothing: the <video> has only data-src and the trigger is a bare button, so no-JS and failed-JS visitors cannot reach the VSL.
evidence: ConversionTemplate VideoScene: <video … preload="none" data-src={vsl.src}> with a <button data-video-open>, and no href fallback.
fix: Render the trigger as that ui.ts upgrades to the dialog, or add .

problem: The Service node's name is the H1 sentence ('30 minutos para ver tu operación como es…') instead of the entity name 'Discovery Session'. og:image:alt nests parentheses ('…primer plano (imagen ilustrativa))'). The mid-scene #para-quien plate has a descriptive alt even though R11 asks for alt="" on non-portada decorative plates.
evidence: JSON-LD @id …/discovery/#service name; the og:image:alt meta tag; in #para-quien.
fix: Set Service.name to 'Discovery Session' (serviceType stays). Build og:image:alt without the nested plate alt. Pass alt="" to the #para-quien ImageSection.

problem: The footer shows commercial figures ('+73 sistemas en producción · 7 países') without the required source note 'Datos internos de Ingeniak, octubre de 2026' (§0.1.2); the note appears 0 times on the page.
evidence: Footer markup: +73 … 7 países. grep 'Datos internos de Ingeniak' in /discovery/ HTML returns 0.
fix: Render the footer figures through <Metric> with SOURCE_NOTE as a visible micro-note or footnote ('Datos internos de Ingeniak, octubre de 2026').
